# SEE GPA Calculator — Seepapers.com

> A free online SEE GPA calculator for Nepali Class 10 students. Calculate your
> NEB (National Examinations Board) Grade Point Average from letter grades or raw
> marks, plan the grades needed for a target GPA, check +2 stream eligibility, and
> generate a SEE marksheet. Runs fully in the browser; no marks are uploaded.

Site: https://tools.seepapers.com
Brand: Seepapers.com
Audience: Class 10 (SEE) students in Nepal and students checking +2 stream eligibility.
Grading system: Official NEB SEE 4.0 scale (A+ = 4.0 down to NG = 0.0), credit-hour weighted.

## Tools
- GPA Calculator: compute SEE GPA from letter grades (A+, A, B+, ...) or raw theory/practical marks.
- GPA Planner: enter a target GPA and see the grade combinations needed to reach it.
- +2 Eligibility Checker: check qualification for Science (GPA >= 2.0), Management (GPA >= 1.6) and Humanities (GPA >= 1.6) streams based on GPA and key subject grades.
- Marksheet / Transcript Generator: build and download a SEE marksheet showing each subject grade, grade point and final GPA.

## Methodology (how SEE GPA is calculated)
1. Each component (theory, practical) is converted to a percentage of its own maximum.
2. The percentage maps to a grade band on the NEB 4.0 scale, each band has a fixed grade point.
3. Subject grade point = weighted average of component grade points (75/25 standard, 50/50 for Computer Science).
4. Final GPA = sum(credit hours x subject GP) / sum(credit hours).
